title: Apple's Embedded SIM Cards May Hurt Telecoms, Benefit Consumers
text:
Apple's Embedded SIM Cards May Hurt Telecoms, Benefit Consumers By 0
Here's what I don't like about all this eSIM chatter floating around about Apple Inc.'s (AAPL) new products.
I break phones. If I don't break them, I keep them for years upon years until they literally die. eSIMs, or embedded SIM cards, are soldered to the inside of the phone, making them permanent.
